description: This file defines a React component 'AssignmentCard' that displays information about an assignment, including title, status, course details, due date, and a CTA link. It also includes internal helper functions 'getCTALabel' and 'getHref' for determining button labels and links based on assignment properties.

methods.name: getCTALabel
methods.description: Determines the call-to-action button label based on the assignment's type and status.

methods.name: getHref
methods.description: Generates the URL for the assignment's detail page based on its type and ID.
